name: private-notify
description: Encrypted native Android notification subscriptions with a Node CLI and FCM sender.

scripts.package:rep: npm run bundle:rep && pkg dist/rep.cjs --targets node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --output dist/rep-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:rep: npm run package:rep && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'C:\Programs' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force 'dist\rep-windows-x64.exe' 'C:\Programs\rep.exe'"
scripts.test: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:fcm
